name: Bahria Town Phase 7: Spring North and Business Square
assumptions: The model covers the OSM Square Commercial polygon only; Spring North has no boundary in any source, and the Clock Tower and the fast food cluster stand about 1.4 km away, so neither is here.
Identifying this polygon as Business Square follows the dossier's inference.
Only Bahria Heights 5 has an OSM outline; all other block outlines are traced by eye from Esri imagery and carry roof lean, so a few metres of error is likely.
Heights: crescent row 16.5 m to the gable apex from a storey count on listing photos (4.5 m arcade, two window floors, attic gable), with storey heights estimated.
Other standalone blocks are set from Esri shadow length relative to Heights 5; roughly 2 m either way.
Heights 5 is 21.7 m to the parapet and 24.6 m to the pavilion peaks, scaled from the developer's render against the 120.8 m OSM length; no as-built photo was found.
Facades of blocks not seen in photos reuse the crescent row's language (cream arcade, sand stucco, grey window modules); some may be unfinished or a different colour.
Low strip blocks along the south road are drawn as two storeys from short Esri shadows; their facades are unseen.
Colours are estimated by eye from listing photos and satellite imagery; none is published. One crescent unit has pinker roofs in Esri, which is not reproduced.
Gables are set on block corners matching the Esri red roof squares; their pitch and the 2.4 m rise are estimates.
Heights 5 round arches, the balustrade across them, and its four pavilions a side follow the developer render and Esri; no as-built facade photo was found.
Red awnings over the top window row are shown on gabled blocks, as in the crescent photos.
Arcades wrap every side of every block; photos only confirm the street sides.
Roads, parking, medians, trees and street lights are left to the game's own systems, so no ground slab covers them; only the crescent's brick forecourt is modelled.
Blocks visibly under construction in Esri are shown finished and flat-roofed.
